pages.text: Health 80, Armor 8, Attack 8, Knockback Resistance 0.6, Movement Speed 0.3.$(br)Wave Bolts$(br)Fires 9 wave bolts for 2–9 drowning damage. If the target is immune to drowning, it deals an equal amount of magic damage instead.

Shockwave$(br)Slams its trident into the ground, releasing an 8-damage shockwave; only used while it still holds a trident.$(br)Thrust$(br)Thrusts forward with its trident, dealing 8 damage once for each trident it has; only used while it still has a trident.
Gemstone Wave$(br)Casts forward to deal 3–18 drowning damage to creatures in front. Only used while it still has a trident.$(br)Conjure Bulge$(br)A Fury Seawave summons 3 Bulges to fight for it.
